scope.description: Input children may be null, undefined, booleans, strings, numbers (including NaN and signed zero), bigint, symbols, functions, finite acyclic arrays (including holes), or ordinary React element/fragment/portal data with scalar keys. Observe count or the complete forEach callback argument/index/receiver sequence, return identity and throws. Iterator/thenable/lazy protocols, library-read getters, nonprimitive key coercion, symbol keys, owner Fiber graphs, aliased callback arguments and input mutations require separate evidence. Unaccessed element warning descriptors remain opaque.
